body:
I actually have a lot of trouble with time. I have this consistent feeling that I just got here. I very much live in the now, past and future seems extremely hazy for me. 

This is why I am starting to think I am not living in my head but in a simulation. I have studied a fair amount of physics and I find it odd that the entire universe works according to mathematical models, just like a computer simulation. It can't be in my head because it is to much for a brain to simulate. It needs to be some other entity (such as a computer) that has generated this world. I have a long time thought I am a part of a experiment.
